projects.name: Job Hunter — AI-Powered Job Application Pipeline
projects.details: Production system that runs daily: scrapes 50+ jobs from Adzuna, Seek, and Careerjet; uses DeepSeek V3 to generate ATS-optimised resumes, cover letters, interview prep, and fit scores; renders professional PDFs via ReportLab; uploads to Google Drive; logs to Google Sheets; sends batch Telegram notifications with Drive links. Fully automated, zero manual intervention. Stack: Python, DeepSeek API, ReportLab, Google Drive/Sheets API, Telegram Bot API, cron.

projects.name: OpenClaw — Self-Hosted AI Agent Gateway
projects.details: Built and deployed a self-hosted AI gateway managing 8+ specialised agents (analytics, automation, career, wellness) across multiple LLM providers (Claude, DeepSeek, ZAI, Moonshot). Includes OAuth token management, skills framework, and Telegram bot integration for real-time agent interaction. Deployed on Linux with systemd, handles routing, failover, and cost optimisation across providers.

projects.name: Life-Control — Multi-Agent Coordination Platform
projects.details: Multi-agent AI coordination system running 8 Telegram bots with a shared SQLite data layer, cron-scheduled health checks, and CLI-based agent management. Agents handle finance tracking, wellness reminders, career automation, and productivity workflows. Stack: Python, SQLite, Telegram Bot API, multi-agent orchestration.

projects.name: Stacked Up HQ — AI Influencer Marketing Platform
projects.details: Designed and deployed a 5-agent AI operations platform for an influencer marketing agency. Agents handle brand research, creator discovery, quality control, and outreach drafting in an automated pipeline. Built with OpenClaw, Telegram integration, cron-based dispatch, and a live dashboard. Client acquired 5 new clients directly through the system. Stack: Python, Node.js, OpenClaw, Telegram API, multi-agent orchestration.

projects.name: ClientOnboard — Full-Stack Onboarding Platform
projects.details: Production-grade client onboarding platform with role-based access control, real-time data sync, and admin dashboard. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, NextAuth.js, and TanStack Query. Deployed on Vercel with PostgreSQL backend. Delivered for an actual business to streamline their client intake process.
